newsitem.title: UK: Iran buys as much as four cargoes white sugar-trade.
newsitem.headline: Iran buys as much as four cargoes white sugar-trade.

text.p: Iran may have bought four cargoes of white sugar this week for shipment between May and July and not the three previously reported, European sugar traders said on Friday.
A leading London trade house was reported to have sold Iran two cargoes of whites, both at $313.00 per tonne, fob basis, for May/June shipment and a further cargo for June/July at $351.00, c & f.
Traders said an Asian house sold Iran a cargo of whites for May/June at $307.25, fob basis.
